# Coding Guidelines

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### 1. Portuguese (pt-BR) domain identifiers

- Classes, methods, columns, routes and log messages use pt-BR: `ProcessoMonitoramento`, `falhas_consecutivas`, `marcarComoFalhou()`, `jaFoiNotificado()`, `/processo/monitoramentos`.
- Framework names stay English (`handle`, `toArray`, `rules`). Rationale: domain language of Brazilian courts (MNI, PJe, CNJ) maps 1:1 to code.
- Verified in `app/Models/*`, `app/Services/*`, `app/Jobs/*`. No enforcement.

### 2. Thin controllers, logic in `app/Services`

- Controllers validate, look up, dispatch; services do SOAP, persistence and side effects.
- `Api\ConsultarProcessoController` → `ProcessoService`; `Api\DownloadProcessoController` → `ExportacaoProcessoService`; `Api\MonitoramentoProcessoController` → `CredencialPjeService`.
- Services resolved by constructor injection or `app(Service::class)` inside jobs (`ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob`, `BaixarDocumentoMNIJob`). No enforcement.

### 3. FormRequest validation; auth stays in middleware

- API write payloads validated in `app/Http/Requests/Api/*` (`CriarMonitoramentoProcessoRequest`, `AtualizarMonitoramentoProcessoRequest`, `CriarExportacaoProcessoRequest`).
- `authorize()` returns `true` with comment `// autenticação é feita pelo middleware ValidateApiToken` (3 files).
- `numero_processo` normalized in `prepareForValidation()` via `cleanNumeroProcesso()` (2 files); GET endpoints call `cleanNumeroProcesso()` in the controller.
- Paired credentials use `nullable` + `required_with` (not `sometimes`) so the pair rule always fires.
- Read `validated()`/`safe()->only()`, not raw `only()` — comment in `MonitoramentoProcessoController::aplicarAtualizacao`.

### 4. Status values as model constants

- `STATUS_*` constants on `Processo`, `ProcessoDocumento`, `ProcessoExportacao`, `ProcessoMonitoramento`, `ProcessoMonitoramentoExecucao`.
- Compare and assign through constants: `ProcessoMonitoramento::STATUS_SUSPENSO`, `ProcessoDocumento::STATUS_BAIXADO`, `ProcessoExportacao::STATUS_FALHOU`. Raw SQL in migrations uses the literal values (`status <> 'cancelado'`, `status = 'baixado'`).

### 5. Public UUIDs, hidden internals

- `uuid` set in `booted()` `creating` hook: `ProcessoMonitoramento`, `ProcessoMonitoramentoExecucao`, `CredencialPje` (`Tribunal` in `boot()` when column exists).
- API addresses resources by `uuid`; `$hidden` drops `id`, foreign keys and secrets (`callback_token`, `login`, `senha`, `login_hash`, `path`, `path_html`).
- Cross-tenant lookups return 404 (`buscarDoToken()` scopes by `api_token_id`).

### 6. Explicit queue per dispatch, retry policy on the job

- Every dispatch names its queue: `->onQueue('monitoramento')`, `'monitoramento-webhook'`, `'exportar-processo'`, `'mni-download'`, `'alta'`; queue names must exist in `config/horizon.php` supervisors.
- Jobs declare `$tries`, `$timeout`, `backoff()` (`EnviarWebhookMonitoramentoJob`, `EnviarWebhookDownloadJob`: `[10, 60, 300, 900, 3600]`; `EnviarParaS3ExportacaoJob`: `[10, 30, 60]`).
- Jobs pass ids (`public int $monitoramentoId`) and reload the model in `handle()`; missing row → `Log::warning` + return.
- `tests/Unit/HorizonConfigTest.php` replicates Horizon's config merge and fails if any supervisor lacks a connection in any environment.

### 7. Idempotent webhook delivery

- `DB::transaction` + `lockForUpdate()` → skip when `jaFoiNotificado()` (`webhook_enviado_em` set) → `increment('webhook_tentativas')` → send.
- `CallbackPermanentException` (4xx) → `$this->fail($e)`; other errors rethrow for queue retry.
- Same shape in `EnviarWebhookMonitoramentoJob` and `EnviarWebhookDownloadJob`.

### 8. Tunables in `config/pje.php`, read via `config()`

- Limits read as `config('pje.monitoramento.max_ativos_por_token')`, `intervalo_min_horas`, `max_falhas_consecutivas`, `bloqueio_despacho_minutos`, `limite_itens_payload` in controller, requests, job, dispatcher, detector.
- `AppServiceProvider` comment: `env()` outside config returns null under `config:cache`. Exception observed: `HorizonServiceProvider` reads `env('HORIZON_ADMIN_EMAILS')` directly.
- `tests/Unit/ConfigPjeTest.php` asserts `pje.credenciais_padrao` maps to `PJE_LOGIN_PADRAO`/`PJE_SENHA_PADRAO`.

### 9. Single entry for MNI errors

- Wrap MNI/PJe failures in `App\Exceptions\MNIException`; its constructor runs `PadronizarMensagemMniService::normalizar()`.
- Read the message with `getError()` (API responses, `erro_resumo`, logs). Covered by `tests/Unit/Exceptions/MNIExceptionTest.php`.

### 10. Log context prefix `[Entidade:{id}]`

- `Log::info("[Monitoramento:{$monitoramento->id}] execução concluída", [...])`, `"[Exportacao:{$exportacao->id}] ..."`, `"[MonitoramentoExecucao:{$id}] ..."`.
- Used in `MonitoramentosDespachar`, `ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob`, `EnviarWebhookMonitoramentoJob`, `GerarPdfExportacaoJob`, `EnviarParaS3ExportacaoJob`, `EnviarWebhookDownloadJob`.
- `Log::critical` for permanent webhook rejection and exhausted retries.

### 11. Why-comments in pt-BR

- Comments explain decisions, not mechanics: route group split in `routes/api.php`, `$tries = 1` in `ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob`, partial unique index in `2026_08_12_000002_create_processo_monitoramentos_table.php`, `balance => 'off'` in `config/horizon.php`.

### 12. Formatting

- UTF-8, LF, 4-space indent, final newline; YAML 2 spaces; `docker-compose.yml` 4 — enforced by `.editorconfig`.
- PHP preset `laravel` (rule `no_unused_imports` disabled), JS + CSS enabled, `index.php` excluded — enforced by `.styleci.yml`.
- `laravel/pint` installed (dev) without `pint.json` or script; no PHPStan, ESLint, Prettier or pre-commit hooks.

### 13. Tests

- Pest `it('<pt-BR sentence>')`, file-level `uses(DatabaseTransactions::class)`.
- Fake I/O: `Queue::fake()`, `Http::fake(['*' => Http::response('', 200)])`, `Storage::fake('s3')`; mock services with `$this->mock(ProcessoService::class, ...)`.
- Auth in tests: `criarTokenApi('mni_monitoramento')` + header `X-API-Token`; isolate env credentials with `definirCredenciaisPadrao(null, null)` (`tests/Pest.php`).
- Payload builders as local functions: `payloadMonitoramento()`, `payloadValidoExportacao()`.

### 14. Frontend (Inertia React)

- TypeScript strict; imports via alias `@/` → `resources/js/*` (`tsconfig.json`); checked by `npm run typecheck`.
- Pages under `resources/js/pages/<area>/<action>.tsx`, rendered by `Inertia::render('<area>/<action>')`.
- UI primitives from shadcn/ui in `resources/js/components/ui/` (`components.json` style `new-york`); class merge via `resources/js/lib/utils.ts`.
